# Overrides for `uv pip compile` (semgrep.txt). An override REPLACES a package's requirement
# wherever it appears, including inside another package's metadata.
#
# semgrep (1.180.0 and 1.181.0, the latest as of 2026-10) declares `mcp==1.29.0` exactly. mcp
# 1.29.0 is vulnerable to GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (unbounded session accumulation in the
# StreamableHTTP transport, fixed in 1.30.0), so the hash-pinned tree cannot be resolved
# normally. The install is `pip install --no-deps --require-hashes`, so pip never checks
# semgrep's declared pin; the override only decides what the lock file records.
#
# Remove this file, the `mcp` line in semgrep.in and the --override flag once a semgrep
# release requires mcp >= 1.30.0.
mcp==1.30.0
